label: FinRecon demo statement (synthetic)
description: The synthetic statement layout used by FinRecon's demo batch. Not a real bank's export.
evidence: Schema is verifiable inside this repository: fixtures/demo/bank.csv is the file this profile describes, and fixtures/demo/bank-profile.json is the same column mapping in its manual-upload form.
